items.question: Can we start with just one service?
items.answer: Yes. We can scope one service around a specific need and consider other services when they become useful.

items.question: How do you price a project?
items.answer: We look at the agreed deliverables, complexity, integrations, and support needs. Your proposal separates our work from any external platform charges.

items.question: What should I bring to the first call?
items.answer: Your business goals, your current website if you have one, and the main challenge you want to discuss are a useful starting point.
